name: Mad Mythicals
displayDescription:
Mad Mythicals permanently improves your chances of pulling Legendary and
Mythical items from coin boxes! Lower tiers become correspondingly less common.

Chance per box opened, without Mad Mythicals -> with Mad Mythicals:

Basic: 54.9149% -> 54.2888%
Uncommon: 27.4574% -> 27.1444%
Rare: 12.3558% -> 12.2150%
Epic: 4.1186% -> 4.0717%
Legendary: 0.9610% -> 1.9001%
Mythical: 0.1922% -> 0.3800%

If you also own Lucky, both sides shift:

Basic: 44.6585% -> 44.0186%
Uncommon: 29.7723% -> 29.3457%
Rare: 18.0867% -> 17.8275%
Epic: 6.0289% -> 5.9425%
Legendary: 1.2504% -> 2.4650%
Mythical: 0.2032% -> 0.4006%

Total odds may not exactly add up to 100% due to rounding.
